app.tagline: Repair help you can talk to

health.error: Server not reachable. Check your network, then try again.

live.empty: Hold the mic and ask about the fault.
live.failed: Can't reach Ustaad. Check your network, then try again.
live.busy: Ustaad is busy with other technicians right now. Try again in a minute.
live.micBlocked: Ustaad can't hear you. Allow the microphone in your browser settings.

gate.G_MAINS_OFF: Switch off the MCB or pull out the plug.
gate.G_CAP_DISCHARGE: Discharge the capacitor and measure it with the multimeter.

evidence.G_MAINS_OFF: Send a photo of the MCB in the OFF position, or of the plug pulled out.
evidence.G_CAP_DISCHARGE: Send a photo of the multimeter reading across the capacitor terminals.

stop.refrigerant: Gas work is only for a certified gas technician. I can help with the other checks.
stop.other: This work isn't safe to guide. Only a trained technician should do it. I can help with the other checks.

source.failed: The voice note didn't play. Check the network, then tap it again.

camera.checking: Ustaad is looking at the photo…
camera.stillChecking: Still checking the photo, it's taking longer than usual…
camera.failed: Photo didn't send. Check the network, then take it again.
camera.dark: Photo is too dark. Turn the flash on and take it again.
camera.blurry: Photo is blurry. Hold the phone still and move a little closer.
camera.ownTitle: Take a photo of what you want to show

stock.title: Stock
stock.error: Stock didn't load. Check your network, then try again.
stock.empty: No parts yet. Tell Ustaad what you bought, like "bought two capacitors".
stock.saveFailed: The count didn't change. Check your network, then try again.

demo.failed: The demo didn't start. Check your network, then try again.
